name: Robert Ehrlich
bio: A Representative from Maryland; born in Arbutus, Howard County, Md., November 25, 1957; B.A., Princeton University, Princeton, N.J., 1979; J.D., Wake Forest University School of Law, Winston-Salem, N.C., 1982; member of the Maryland state general assembly, 1987-1994; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Fourth and to the three succeeding Congresses (January 3, 1995-January 3, 2003); not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Eighth Congress in 2002; Governor of Maryland, 2003-2007; unsuccessful candidate for governor of Maryland in 2010.
